summary: Query and act on Evite (evite.com) events, guest lists, RSVPs, and messages from a shell with curl and a cookie jar — instead of running the evite-mcp server. Does a headless EVITE_EMAIL/EVITE_PASSWORD login against evite.com's internal /services/, /ajax/, and /tsunami/ APIs, no browser or extension involved. Use when you want Evite data/actions without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed. Triggers on "check my Evite", "Evite guest list", "RSVP on Evite from the shell", "curl Evite", "evite-api skill".
